headline: Discussed how to search for a new superintendent, including public interviews of finalists and community input.
summary: Zeal, the consultant, plans a stakeholder engagement week to gather input from students, teachers and parents. The process would narrow 8 to 10 candidates to 5 to 7 semi-finalists, then 2 or 3 finalists, who would be interviewed in open session. Before the next meeting, the committee will develop a plan for interview structures and public communication.
